metric: general search interest per AI product, 3-month, relative to ChatGPT = 1.0
note: True public search POPULARITY (how much the whole web searches each tool), via Google Trends. ChatGPT dominates so hard it crushes everything else when compared directly against it, so the tail is measured by bridging through mid-tier anchors (grok -> perplexity -> meta-ai -> ...), never ChatGPT. grok and character-ai corrected for term undercount (bare 'grok', 'character ai' without the dot). Primary order for the board; GSC only breaks exact ties. Refresh from a residential IP / in-browser (datacenter IPs get 302'd).
